added.name: P7847
added.reason: Adds a 2022–2025 optical decline after an earlier rise; W1 turns down after its 2023 annual maximum. Extends the fading sample with an already-observed low-redshift nucleus.

added.name: P9506
added.reason: Adds sustained infrared decline from the mid-2010s through 2024 with a non-monotonic optical history and recent optical brightening. The different histories constrain delayed response; not classified as a new line transition.

added.name: P8499
added.reason: Catalogue turn-on anchor with large optical rise to 2021 followed by decline, and a W1 peak in 2022 followed by decline. Extends the range of variability amplitudes and optical/IR timing.

added.name: P13030
added.reason: Catalogue CLAGN with historical fading and a repeating-transition candidacy; saved optical light curves brighten through 2025 and W1 recovers after a 2019 minimum in flux. Adds an independent recovery history, not a newly confirmed recurrence.

added.name: P24541
added.reason: Catalogue CLAGN and repeating-transition candidate; optical data brighten from 2020 to 2023 and W1 recovers after 2020. Optical sampling is sparse and needs a better onset bracket.

added.name: P21240
added.reason: Optical rise to 2020, decline through 2024, then brightening in 2025; W1 has a different, slower trend. Adds a reversal history for joint temporal fitting.

added.name: P20040
added.reason: Catalogue CLAGN with historical spectral change and infrared decline to a relatively steady recent state. Adds a longer-history anchor; recent optical variation is weak and host dilution must be assessed.

selection_basis: Documented variability histories, redshift coverage and usable archival W3/W4 measurements; NGPS-observed sources prioritized. Existing sources retained provisionally. Manifold location does not gate the additions.

statistical_design.purpose: Replicated comparisons of dust-response residuals among history classes and versus continuous event-age/lag; a targeted sample, not a population-rate survey.
statistical_design.primary_comparison: Brightening versus fading in the log hot-to-warm dust-continuum ratio residual under the fixed-distribution model; recovery is a secondary comparison.
statistical_design.assumptions: Illustrative independent equal-variance measurements, common within-group total scatter. Not a power forecast; correlated calibration/model errors and unequal precision reduce the gain.
